# Repro: next.js#66292 — Tailwind CSS not regenerated by HMR inside an intercepting route (webpack dev)

Minimal App Router app: `/` links to `/product/1`, which is intercepted by the
`@modal` parallel route at `app/@modal/(.)product/[id]/page.jsx`.

## Steps

```bash
npm install
npm run dev            # next 14.2.3, webpack dev server
```

1. Open http://localhost:3000 and click "Open product 1" (the intercepted modal renders,
   `#modal` has `w-full bg-red-500`).
2. While the intercepted route is showing, edit
   `app/@modal/(.)product/[id]/page.jsx` and change the classes to `w-2/12 bg-blue-500`.
3. Fast Refresh reports "done", the DOM `class` attribute updates, but the new Tailwind
   utilities are never added to the dev stylesheet: `#modal` keeps `width: 1280px` and a
   transparent background.
4. Reloading the page and navigating from `/` again applies the new styles, proving the
   classes were only missing from the HMR-updated CSS.

Editing the same classes on the non-intercepted `app/product/[id]/page.jsx` updates
correctly, so the bug is specific to files under the intercepting route.

## Automated check

```bash
npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium
npm run dev &
npm run hmr-test
```

## Versions observed

| next | result |
| --- | --- |
| 14.2.3 | BROKEN — new utilities never reach the browser after HMR |
| 14.2.35 | OK |
| 15.5.23 (webpack) | OK |
| 16.3.2 (`next dev --webpack`) | OK |
